test_sniff_delimiter: test the python parser auto-detects CSV delimiter when sep is None
test_on_bad_lines_callable: test the python parser on_bad_lines callable handles malformed CSV rows gracefully
test_skipfooter: test the python parser skips trailing footer rows in CSV data
test_encoding_non_utf8_multichar_sep: test the python parser handles multi-character separators with non-UTF-8 encodings
test_no_thousand_convert_with_dot_for_no: test the python parser respects thousands separator only for numeric columns
